title: HID
description: HID is an EEG dataset in BIDS format with HED (Hierarchical Event Descriptors) annotations, contributed by Tony Johnson, Stephen Gordon, Jon Touryan, and Kevin King. The recordings are stored as EEGLAB files (.set/.fdt) with HED version 8.1.0 event annotations. The dataset is distributed through NEMAR and derives from an OpenNeuro deposit (ds004851).
methods_description: Electroencephalography (EEG) recordings are organized according to BIDS (version 1.8.0) and stored in EEGLAB format (.set/.fdt files). Events are annotated with HED (Hierarchical Event Descriptors) version 8.1.0. Data organization and formatting was performed using bids-matlab-tools (version 8.0). The dataset is derived from OpenNeuro dataset ds004851 (DOI: 10.18112/openneuro.ds004851.v2.1.0). Recording parameters are provided in the JSON sidecars accompanying the recording files.
